sources.quote: WASP-4b is an exoplanet, specifically a hot Jupiter, approximately 891 light-years away in the constellation of Phoenix.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-4. Its orbit and size follow Baştürk et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
